summary: OHV rolled over on Engineer Pass with two patients aboard; OMRT, Ouray Fire, Ouray EMS, and the Ouray County Sheriff's Office responded jointly to extract them.
responding_agency: Ouray Mountain Rescue Team; Ouray Volunteer Fire Department; Ouray County EMS; Ouray County Sheriff's Office
notes: Post dated 8/14 says 'yesterday afternoon'. Described as two patients requiring coordinated rescue. Pass straddles the Ouray/Hinsdale line; filed Ouray (Ouray-led response).
